reason: A DSH integration plugin that retrieves provider model catalogs and usage quotas, writes new model IDs into settings, and visualizes session limits and balances in the interface.

summaries.zh: 从多个模型提供商获取模型列表与用量信息，将新模型写入 DSH 设置，并在界面中显示会话配额和余额。
summaries.en: Fetches model lists and usage data from multiple providers, adds new models to DSH settings, and displays session quotas and balances in the interface.

capabilities: Fetches provider model lists and quota or balance data from external APIs
Reads credentials already stored in DSH
Writes model identifiers into DSH provider settings
Writes a local usage baseline file
Displays usage and quota information in settings and the composer UI
